summary: @servicetitan/anvil-icon preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package is published under the @servicetitan scope and its files list contains only SVG icons under mdi/, but package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifier mangling with string-array proxies) and, on install, downloads the Bun runtime ZIP from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (pinned v1.3.13) to a temp directory, extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle using a shuffled-string-array rotator (WV8StW) and mangled top-level identifiers, whose behavior is opaque to review. Executing an obfuscated sibling bundle via a downloaded alternate runtime at npm install time is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: Node-based tooling and reviewers never see the code that actually runs, and the executed payload is entirely unrelated to the declared SVG icon purpose. The scope name aligns with ServiceTitan, creating a dependency-confusion / scope-impersonation surface against organizations that build against ServiceTitan-internal package names.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
